title: Signature Art of the Paired Rifle
summary: Gives the Azure Sky's pair-fire discipline to partnered riflemen, from first stance to the school's own signature volley.

title: The Azure Court Rifleman's Signature Book
summary: Records the school's court-trained rifle craft, built on twin rests, held beats and a closing fire shared by two.

title: Basin and River: The Marksman's Signature Discipline
summary: Teaches ground-reading along basin slopes and river banks, ending in the school's unbroken line of fire down a basin.

title: The Higher Signature Canon of the Paired Barrels
summary: Sets out the highest mortal form of pair rifle craft, in which two barrels act with a single will.

title: The Dual-Track Signature of the Field Rifle
summary: Teaches a qi-field cultivator the school's two-track rifle art, joining field, barrel and perch into one long shot.

title: Treatise on the Core-Formed Long Rifle
summary: Shows a Core-formed rifleman how to feed shot, step and cover from the Core, ending in the school's crowning shot.
